stemMarkdown: A rectangular garden 35 m by 18 m is surrounded by a path 5 m wide running all around it on the outside. Find the area (in square m) of the path.
solutionMarkdown: The outer rectangle measures $45$ m by $28$ m, an area of $1260$ square m. Subtracting the garden's $630$ square m leaves $630$.
altSolutionMarkdown: The path widens the plot on both sides, so each dimension grows by twice the width.
